title: Glowing armchair
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- backrest -->
  <rect x="22" y="18" width="56" height="40" rx="12" fill="#e8643a"/>
  <rect x="28" y="24" width="44" height="28" rx="8" fill="#f58a5c"/>
  <!-- seat cushion -->
  <rect x="18" y="52" width="64" height="20" rx="8" fill="#d94f2b"/>
  <rect x="24" y="56" width="52" height="12" rx="6" fill="#f07040"/>
  <!-- left armrest -->
  <rect x="8" y="36" width="16" height="40" rx="8" fill="#f58a5c"/>
  <rect x="11" y="40" width="10" height="30" rx="5" fill="#ffad7a"/>
  <!-- right armrest -->
  <rect x="76" y="36" width="16" height="40" rx="8" fill="#f58a5c"/>
  <rect x="79" y="40" width="10" height="30" rx="5" fill="#ffad7a"/>
  <!-- front skirt -->
  <rect x="20" y="68" width="60" height="12" rx="4" fill="#c23e1e"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="24" y="80" width="8" height="10" rx="3" fill="#a33218"/>
  <rect x="68" y="80" width="8" height="10" rx="3" fill="#a33218"/>
  <!-- cushion button highlights -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="62" r="2.5" fill="#ffc4a8"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="62" r="2.5" fill="#ffc4a8"/>
  <!-- glow halo around the chair -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="54" rx="46" ry="40" fill="none" stroke="#ffd9a0" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.35"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="54" rx="42" ry="36" fill="none" stroke="#ffb347" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.25"/>
</svg>
